about: ^report(47), experiment 5, Fumola's side: the Witch's picture (046/data/witch/picture.json) into a Fumola instance by fumola_define_json, and out to JS values by fumola_eval_top (value_to_json, the tagged JSON the Hazel side decodes) then JSON.parse. wasm32 release build, wasm-bindgen --target nodejs, Node v22.23.2 on the laptop; ms per call, the median of five batches of at least 25 ms. This script is exp_718_fumola_js.js beside this file. Three runs of the script, one after another; eval_top_constant is the same call on the program 0, the control.
